name: Sand Scout
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, search your library for a Desert card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere, create a 1/1 red, green, and white Sand Warrior creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere, create a 1/1 red, green, and white Sand Warrior creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.

needs.what: a trigger event that fires when one or more cards matching a filter (here: land cards, owner = you) are put into a graveyard from ANY zone -- battlefield (sacrifice, destroy), hand (discard), library (mill, surveil), stack -- supporting `batched: true` so one simultaneous move of several land cards triggers once ("one or more"); the printed "triggers only once each turn" is then the existing `max_per_turn: 1`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no generic zone-change-to-graveyard event: leaves_battlefield with to_zones ["graveyard"] (the loader accepts to_zones on leaves_battlefield only) and dies see only permanents leaving the battlefield and miss discarded, milled and surveilled land cards; discard covers only the hand; leaves_graveyard is the opposite direction. Combining leaves_battlefield and discard triggers would still miss mill and could fire twice for one event. The token (sand_warrior_1_1_rgw), the max_per_turn cap and the enters line (self_enters trigger with a land-count condition, search_library for a Desert onto the battlefield tapped) are expressible today. Note the packet's starting_point carries a spurious self_enters_tapped replacement: Sand Scout itself does not enter tapped, only the fetched Desert does.
